about: TS checker (web/src/lib/verify.ts, checkerTest.ts) vs Rust checker (core/atlas-verify, WebAssembly). Spans are [start, end] in UTF-16 units; "undefined"/"NaN" are the TS checker's own offsets after U+0130 (see README).

AFTER VISIT SUMMARY
Sample Patient   DOB: 01/01/1970   Visit: 10/01/2026   Midtown Family Medicine (sample clinic)
Provider: Sample Provider, MD

Reason for visit: Follow-up for high blood sugar and blood pressure.

Your diagnoses today:
- Type 2 diabetes mellitus without complications (E11.9)
- Essential hypertension (I10)

Medication changes
START taking these medications:
- metformin (GLUCOPHAGE) 500 mg tablet. Take 1 tablet by mouth 2 times a day with meals.
CHANGE how you take these medications:
- lisinopril 10 mg tablet. Take 2 tablets (20 mg total) by mouth once daily. Previously 10 mg once daily.
STOP taking these medications:
- ibuprofen (ADVIL) 200 mg tablet. Avoid NSAIDs due to kidney function.

Orders placed today
- Hemoglobin A1c - due in 3 months
- Basic metabolic panel - fasting, complete within 2 weeks at any Quest or Labcorp location
- Referral to Ophthalmology for diabetic eye exam. Their office will call you to schedule. If you have not heard from them in 10 days, call 404-555-0134.

Follow-up
Return to clinic in 3 months, or sooner if needed.

Patient instructions
Check your blood sugar every morning before breakfast and write down the number. Bring your log to your next visit.
Walk 30 minutes, 5 days a week, as tolerated.
Limit sugary drinks such as soda and sweet tea.

When to seek care
Call the office if your blood sugar is above 300 two times in a row.
Call 911 or go to the nearest emergency room if you have chest pain, trouble breathing, or sudden weakness on one side of your body.

EMERGENCY DEPARTMENT DISCHARGE INSTRUCTIONS
Sample Child   Age 7   Discharged 10/01/2026
Diagnosis: Asthma exacerbation

Medicines
Albuterol inhaler: 2 puffs with spacer every 4 hours as needed for wheezing or cough.
Prednisolone 15 mg by mouth once daily for 5 days. Start tomorrow morning.

Follow-up
See your pediatrician in 2 to 3 days.

Home care
Keep your child away from cigarette smoke.

Return to the emergency department right away if your child's lips turn blue or they are struggling to breathe.

ED attending reviewed chest x-ray: no pneumonia.
sources.paper:hypertension-new-med:
VISIT SUMMARY - Sample Health Center
Reason: High blood pressure

New medicine: amlodipine 5 mg, take 1 tablet every morning.
Check your blood pressure at home once a day and write it down. Bring the log to your next visit.
Lab: basic metabolic panel in 1 week at any lab location.
Referral: cardiology. Please call 404-555-0177 to schedule.
Next visit: 4 weeks.
Cut back on salt.

Go to the emergency room if your blood pressure is over 180/120 and you have a severe headache, chest pain, or vision changes.
sources.paper:uti-urgent-care:
URGENT CARE VISIT - SAMPLE
Diagnosis: urinary tract infection

Take nitrofurantoin 100 mg by mouth 2 times a day for 5 days. Finish all of it even if you feel better.
Drink plenty of water.
We sent a urine culture. We will call you if the results mean your medicine needs to change.

Come back or go to the ER if you get a fever over 101 F, back or side pain, or vomiting.
sources.paper:prenatal-28-weeks:
PRENATAL VISIT SUMMARY (SAMPLE)
Weeks pregnant: 28

Today you received the Tdap vaccine.
Start iron (ferrous sulfate) 325 mg by mouth once daily.
Glucose tolerance test at your next visit. Do not eat or drink anything but water for 8 hours before.
Count your baby's kicks every evening.
Next visit in 2 weeks.

Call us right away or go to Labor and Delivery if you have bleeding, leaking fluid, or fewer than 10 movements in 2 hours.
sources.paper:heart-failure-discharge:
HOSPITAL DISCHARGE SUMMARY - FOR PATIENT (SAMPLE)
You were treated for heart failure.

Medicines
Furosemide 40 mg: take 1 tablet every morning.
STOP taking ibuprofen and naproxen.

Every day
Weigh yourself every morning after using the bathroom and write it down.
Limit salt to 2,000 mg a day.

Appointments
Cardiology follow-up in 7 days. The clinic will call you with the time.
Blood work (kidney function) in 1 week.

Call your doctor if you gain more than 3 pounds in a day or 5 pounds in a week, or your legs swell more.
Call 911 if you cannot catch your breath.
